newsitem.title: USA: FGIC names Shaw chief credit officer.
newsitem.headline: FGIC names Shaw chief credit officer.

text.p: Financial Guaranty Insurance Co said Tuesday it named Michael Shaw chief credit officer.

FGIC, a unit of General Electric's GE Capital Services, said Shaw would also be a member of the company's corporate leadership team and report directly to Ann Stern, FGIC's president, chairman and chief executive officer.
Shaw was previously the senior credit officer and risk manager at Citicorp Mortgage, a unit of Citicorp, where he managed a $31 billion asset portfolio.
"His 25 years of experience in consumer credit products, corporate finance, public finance and capital markets transactions make him an ideal chief credit officer for us," Stern said in a statement.
